nodes.label: Dynamic Onset Segmentation
nodes.rationale: Instead of an exhaustive dense temporal grid, the system uses Librosa's onset detection to identify transient acoustic events. It extracts precise 500ms chunks to capture sharp sounds.

nodes.label: Query Ensemble & Expansion
nodes.rationale: For text queries, the system generates an ensemble of up to 7 phrasings. These are embedded via CLAP, with the original text weighted 2x, and averaged to form a highly robust, discriminative query vector.

nodes.label: Hybrid Search Execution
nodes.rationale: Combines PostgreSQL full-text search index (with a pg_trgm fallback) to catch exact spoken words, ranking these at the top. Simultaneously, a cosine distance calculation via pgvector retrieves the top acoustic candidates.

nodes.label: Temporal Attention Reranking
nodes.rationale: Acoustic candidates are strictly filtered via absolute distance thresholds specific to their resolution tier. Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) is applied to prevent overlapping highlight events, returning precise, isolated temporal hits.

nodes.label: Corpus Mapping
nodes.rationale: Visualizes unstructured audio by fetching embeddings, applying PCA to reduce 512D down to 3D, and running K-Means clustering. Calculates 95th-percentile distances from cluster centers to flag acoustic outliers.

nodes.label: Scroll-Driven Animations
nodes.rationale: Fallback strategy for unsupported browsers using IntersectionObserver.
